notes: New direction under the hood: the Infotainer pipeline. Notifications now also flow through an on-device intelligence layer — a rule filter drops media, silent system alerts, and duplicates, then Gemini Nano (on-device via AICore, nothing sent to any cloud) extracts the things worth tracking — tickets, flights, deliveries, bills, 2FA codes, messages that need you — into a local database. Kinto also appears in the share sheet now: share a confirmation email into Kinto and it is parsed the same way. No visible changes yet; surfacing and smart actions are the next steps.
